supersession_reason: Generator scope absorbed into the Practice Primitives program: stats generators ship with Track D (P8/P9/P10 primitives), geometry generators with Track C (P4/P5/P13), trig generators with Track E (P6/P7/P2-trig). Generators are authored alongside their primitive/consuming component rather than in a standalone track. See measure/practice-primitives-roadmap.md.
deviation_notes: Spec/plan retained in archive as reference for per-track generator deliverables; no tasks were implemented before supersession.
